_note: Research-backed aesthetic briefs for image generation. Not served to clients.

flamengo.real: Flamingo Authentic Mexican Cuisine & Ice Cream, 1029 Pleasant St, DeKalb — dual Mexican restaurant + ice cream parlor in a residential strip; spacious casual dining, chips with multiple salsas, birria, giant burritos, nieves/paletas/licuados
flamengo.avoid: fine-dining white tablecloth, upscale margarita lounge, moody romantic Mexican
flamengo.look: casual family Mexican + bright ice-cream parlor energy; Formica/booth casual; colorful desserts; generous plates

china-house.real: China House buffet, 1900 Sycamore Rd, DeKalb — Chinese buffet with hibachi cook-to-order, fresh sushi, crystal chandeliers, clean spacious dining room, kid-friendly (pizza/fries/ice cream machine)
china-house.avoid: intimate lantern tea-house, dark fine dining, single plated tasting dishes only
china-house.look: bright clean buffet lines, hibachi grill station, sushi platter, chandelier dining room, family plates

leza-nail-spa.real: LeZa Nail Spa, 2444 Sycamore Rd — 12 manicure + 16 pedicure stations, modern clean Midwest spa, walk-ins, lemonade, nail art with gems/glitter
leza-nail-spa.look: busy modern nail spa stations, pedicure chairs in rows, realistic gel/chrome nail art, warm welcoming

noon-whistle-brewing.real: Noon Whistle Naperville botanical taproom — Drink.Sip.Sprout., plants for sale, hazy IPAs/sours, industrial biergarten, pinball, food trucks, community
noon-whistle-brewing.avoid: dark industrial brewery with no plants, generic copper tanks only
noon-whistle-brewing.look: plant-filled taproom, flight of craft beer, kettle sour, pretzel+beer cheese, food truck outside, dog-friendly patio

kiss-the-sky.real: Kiss the Sky Records since 1996, downtown Batavia — new/used vinyl, Cloud Nine vintage shop-within-shop, posters, incense, live music venue, Fox River Valley
kiss-the-sky.avoid: sterile Apple-store music shop, neon cyberpunk
kiss-the-sky.look: crate-digger vinyl walls, used LP bins, turntable counter, band posters, vintage Cloud Nine corner, spinning record

hinks-bar-and-grill.real: Hink's Bar & Grill, downtown Sycamore — 100+ beers, bourbon, biker-friendly, karaoke Tue, homemade pizza via dumbwaiter, pretzel rolls, grouper, worn neighborhood bar
hinks-bar-and-grill.look: worn brick corner bar, deep bottle coolers, hand-pattied burger, karaoke mic, motorcycles out front

inbodens-meats.real: Inboden's since 1962 — full-service butcher + deli + bakery + specialty grocery, USDA, local pork/beef, catering/pig roast
inbodens-meats.look: classic Midwest meat market glass case, hand-cut steaks, house brats, deli subs, specialty shelves

lord-stanleys.real: Lord Stanley's & Annex downtown DeKalb — sports bar, pitchers + JB's pizza deal, Blackhawks nights, pool/gaming, dive-friendly
lord-stanleys.look: downtown sports bar TVs, pizza+pitchers, pool table, crowded game night, craft taps in Annex

lisle-lanes.real: Lisle Lanes — bowling + leagues + bar & grill, cosmic glow bowling, stone-baked pizza, wings
lisle-lanes.look: retro lanes, cosmic neon weekend, league night, birthday parties, lane-side pitchers and pizza

bowlrrito.real: Bowlrrito DeKalb — Tex-Mex fast-casual build-your-own bowls & burritos, avocado-lime energy
bowlrrito.look: Chipotle-style line, loaded bowls, foil burritos, guacamole station, agua fresca, bright casual

mad-batter-bakery.real: Mad Batter Bakery St. Charles — from-scratch pastries, custom cakes, glass case confections
mad-batter-bakery.look: butter croissants, hand-decorated cakes, cookie case, brownies, sourdough, truffles

paw-lickin-good.real: Paw Lickin' Good Sycamore — dog bakery, pupcakes, boutique toys, self-wash station
paw-lickin-good.look: dog biscuits, birthday pupcakes, toy shelves, natural chews, DIY wash tub, happy dogs at counter

nona-jos.real: Nona Jo's Naperville home & gift boutique — candles, throws, jewelry, baby gifts, seasonal
nona-jos.look: curated boutique shelves, candle display, window-styled throws, gift wrapping, soft sage warmth

mvps-sports-bar.real: MVP Sports Bar Sycamore — wings, every game on, beer buckets, packed house
mvps-sports-bar.look: jumbo wings, wall of TVs, beer buckets, sampler platter, cheering crowd, nachos/sliders
